title: 第9章 蛇精现原形但离颂情况更严重-《同时被N个S级哨兵盯上怎么办》
content:
第(1/3)页

    这个肖恩，为了给队友开脱还真是费尽了力气！

    秦夙作为受害者，不可能让他得逞的！

    虽然头还晕乎乎的，但已经没有S级的压制，她能行动！

    跳起来朝肖恩冲过去！

    秦夙把右手抬的高高的指着肖恩的脸，“他精神污染90%就可以为所欲为？”

    肖恩一愣，没想到这个初来乍到的小向导，居然会直接跟他杠上。

    秦夙手指尖再往前戳，“他如果真的在乎萧岑，也该对继承这副身体的我表现出一点尊重才对吧？”

    接着，她必须戳穿肖恩偷换概念的诡计，“你说这么多，是能给诺亚增加一点悲剧色彩，也可能给他挣一点同情分，但如果用他处境艰难的借口就能给他脱罪，那我算什么？”

    秦夙再指自己的鼻子尖，“我活该被你们弄来这个星球，装进一副已故向导的身躯，成为你们可以再次利用的战略资源，然后还要随你们揉圆搓扁？”

    越说，她就越气的不行，“我就必须心怀感恩的接受所有无礼的对待？唯一肯帮我的谢尘无要被罚关禁闭，你们却个个都能逍遥法外是吧？！”

    话到这里，她一个个，把肖恩、蕾拉和被提在半空快窒息的诺亚都指了一遍。

    最后更是连离颂都没放过，也指了过去。

    “那我请问，你们这个白塔还有没有军规纪律，你们这群哨兵，还有没有公道良知了！”

    离颂：“……”

    “你……”肖恩苦恼的捏捏眉心，“我并不是针对你。”

    诺亚得罪了离颂，他总得帮帮忙，不能放着不管。何况白塔到处都遍布监控，这层楼发生的冲突很快就会被高层发现。

    把事闹大了，大家都吃不了兜着走，对谁都没好处。

    “你现在扮演理中客这么帮诺亚说话就是针对我！”秦夙把手一甩，“你助纣为虐，你为虎作伥！你跟蕾拉的圣母心和诺亚的骚扰狂性质都一样，都是蛇鼠一窝狼狈为奸的大坏蛋！”

    肖恩：……李忠克是谁？哪个小队的？

    说完她转头跑到离颂身边，“离队，你要是不给我主持公道，那你……你……”

    离颂那对漆黑如墨的眸子又一次转向她。

    犹如无底的深渊，带着强大的吸力一般，秦夙的勇气一下就被抽干了。

    她一怂，“你自己看着办吧。”
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

This Sean really tried his best to excuse his teammates!

As a victim, Qin Su could not let him succeed!

Although her head is still dizzy, she can move without the S-class suppression!

Jump up and rush towards Sean!

Qin Su raised his right hand high and pointed it at Sean's face, "If he is 90% mentally polluted, he can do whatever he wants?"

Sean was stunned. He didn’t expect that this little guide who had just arrived would confront him directly.

Qin Su poked his fingertips forward, "If he really cares about Xiao Cen, he should show some respect for me who inherited this body, right?"

Next, she had to expose Sean's trick of secretly changing concepts, "By saying so much, you can add a bit of tragedy to Noah, and you may also earn him some sympathy points, but if you can use the excuse that he is in a difficult situation to get him off the hook, then who am I?"

Qin Su pointed to the tip of his nose again, "I deserve to be brought to this planet by you, put into the body of a deceased guide, and become a strategic resource that you can use again, and then have to be rounded and flattened by you?"

The more she spoke, the angrier she became, "Do I have to accept all the rude treatment with gratitude? The only one who is willing to help me, Xie Chenwu, is going to be punished in solitary confinement, but you all can get away with it, right?!"

At this point, she pointed at Sean, Layla, and Noah who was almost suffocating after being lifted up in the air.

In the end, he didn’t even let Li Song go and pointed at him.

"Then let me ask you, do you, the White Tower, still have military discipline? Do you, the sentries, still have a sense of fairness and conscience?"

Li Song: "..."

"You..." Sean pinched his eyebrows in distress, "I'm not targeting you."

Noah had offended Li Song, he had to help, he couldn't just leave it alone.What's more, there are surveillance cameras everywhere in the White Tower, and conflicts on this floor will soon be discovered by the higher-ups.

It will do no good to anyone if the matter becomes too big and everyone can't afford it.

"You are targeting me now when you act like a right-winger and speak for Noah so much!" Qin Su threw his hand away, "You are helping the villain, you are the villain! You and Layla's Virgin Heart and Noah's harassing nature are the same. They are both big bad guys working together in a den of snakes and rats!"

Sean: ...who is Li Zhongke?Which team?

After saying that, she turned around and ran to Li Song, "Li team, if you don't give me justice, then you...you..."

Li Song's pair of dark eyes turned to her again.

Like a bottomless abyss, with a strong suction force, Qin Su's courage was drained away in an instant.

She hesitated and said, "You can figure it out yourself."

title_en: Chapter 9 The snake spirit appears in its original form, but Li Song’s situation is even more serious - "What to do if you are targeted by N S-class sentries at the same time"
